phase: Complete; X/Y locked before A/B; mapping undisclosed to reviewer
scope: Visible physical grounding, local light, material distinction and room completeness; excludes surrounding 2D UI, source, tests, runtime constraints, animation and gameplay.

evidence: Stronger contact/shadow integration around the central table, floor transitions and shelf contents.
Locally motivated light reveals adjacent wood, metal, glass, framed artwork and bone with distinguishable surface response.
Layered trim, joinery, overlapping objects and varied prop placement fill the room with a consistent authored environment.
Y is readable and coherent, but broad repeated wood/plaster, uniform prop silhouettes and simpler material/contact response leave it visibly less finished.
The advantage persists in the brighter wall-sconce and central-table areas; the decision is not based on darker exposure.
xy.blindness_limits: The source labels are concealed, but visible branding, crop, resolution, format and potentially recognizable imagery can compromise full identity blindness. No identity lookup or source inspection was performed.

criteria.evidence: A shapes the tabletop with a broad warm highlight, keeps shelf recesses and chair undercuts shaded, and concentrates brightness near the left wall sconce. B spreads similar brightness across large wood areas and adds conspicuous warm/cool ceiling spots that feel less integrated.

A separates polished dark desk wood, brass edging and mechanisms, green upholstery and rug, pale arch stone and mottled wall more convincingly. B reveals wood grain, but the desk, floor, shelves and wall panels share a similar pale, uniform response and repeated texture.

The furniture view gives A stronger readable depth beneath the desk, between chair seat and arms, and around shelf contents. Floor/furniture relationships in B read more diagrammatically because broad fill reduces these occlusion cues.
B makes the grain and smaller floor/wainscot details easier to inspect. This is a real readability benefit but does not by itself make the room more physically convincing.

The paired views show essentially the same room arrangement, sparse shelves, symmetrical architecture, repeated furniture forms and simple mascot. Lighting changes do not add environmental depth or authored detail.

ab.not_a_darkness_preference: A wins in directly lit regions too: its tabletop highlight, chair trim and brass objects separate materials more convincingly. Its shadowed regions are not automatically counted as better; some left-wall and shelf detail is too subdued.
remaining_lighting_limits: A still leaves some side-wall and shelf detail hard to read.
Contact and material cues remain much simpler than X, especially at small shelf props and large flat wood surfaces.
These images alone cannot establish whether a particular light or material implementation is physically accurate.

biggest_remaining_visible_gap.title: Authored environmental completeness and material diversity
biggest_remaining_visible_gap.evidence: Compared with X, the reviewed room relies on large repeated wood/plaster regions, evenly spaced sparse shelves and clean uniform prop silhouettes. X sustains variation in joinery, geometry, object scale, wear, overlap and surface response from floor to ceiling. That gap remains in both A and B.
biggest_remaining_visible_gap.actionable_outcome: Keep the visual qualities of A as the lighting/material direction, then complete one representative room section to a much higher asset-finish standard: detailed shelf construction and varied books/objects; believable wood grain direction and finish variation; clearly separate cloth, leather, painted metal, brass, glass and stone; grounded clutter and overlaps that fit the room narrative. Carry that density and quality across the room rather than filling only the central hero area. Re-review the same room and furniture cameras against X at comparable 3D viewport scale.
acceptance_signals: Furniture and shelf props feel seated with visible local contact and reflected-light cues.
At least the principal material families read distinctly in both lit and shadowed regions without relying only on color.
No large architectural region feels like a repeated generic surface next to one finished hero prop.
Object variety and room dressing feel intentionally inhabited and functionally plausible.
Room-wide finish meets or exceeds X in grounded materials and authored environmental detail, not merely exposure or UI polish.
biggest_remaining_visible_gap.character_limit: The visible simple floating mascot supports a style direction but does not establish complete character quality. Static images cannot establish animation, acting, interaction, or gameplay completeness; those are outside this review.
